intro: Flared, bright and dance-ready – outfits for nine nights of garba
heading: What to wear for Navratri

p: For Navratri garba and dandiya, wear something bright that flares and lets you move for hours: a flared Anarkali, a chaniya choli or a kurta set with a light dupatta. Sequins, mirror work and gota catch the lights; breathable cotton keeps you cool on crowded dance floors. Many women follow the nine colours of Navratri, one for each night.

list: Choose a flare that moves but does not tangle around your feet.
Pin your dupatta or skip it for fast garba rounds.
Comfortable juttis or flats – you will dance for hours.
Abroad in October? Garba halls are warm, but take a layer for the walk outside.

faq: What should I wear for garba night?
A flared Anarkali, chaniya choli or kurta set in a bright colour – with flats and a pinned dupatta so you can dance freely.
Can I wear an Anarkali for dandiya?
Yes – a calf- or ankle-length flared Anarkali is ideal; it twirls beautifully and stays comfortable.
